candidates.change_summary: Remove the require that sender equals owner, allowing any caller to invoke sendTo.
Remove the require that receiver is not zero address, allowing transfer to zero address which will revert but changes behavior by changing condition under which function succeeds.
Remove the require that amount is greater than zero.
Change amount > 0 to amount >= 0, allowing zero-amount transfers.
Delete the transfer call, so no funds are sent.
Replace the transfer call with a call to a different address, e.g., sending to owner instead of receiver.
